purpose: Prevent known pre-cutover aggregate-heartbeat failures from being re-reported forever as current execution gaps after recovery has already been attempted.

legacy_gap_classification.name: HISTORICAL_ARCHITECTURE_GAP
legacy_gap_classification.definition: The scheduler/task ran under the old aggregate-heartbeat architecture, but full authoritative end-state evidence could not be persisted or reconstructed.
legacy_gap_classification.after_one_recovery_pass: If Safety Net performs the configured 48h recovery, finds no qualifying missed role, and no current CRITICAL ledger state remains, move the gap to historical_uncertainty. It remains auditable but must not by itself make future Safety Net runs INCOMPLETE or trigger repeated user-facing coverage warnings.
legacy_gap_classification.never_claim: Do not claim 100% historical coverage for the affected interval.

current_gap_rule: Only a new slot at or after the applicable per-run-receipt cutover may be treated as a current execution gap solely from missing/stale/invalid run evidence.
warning_rule: A historical_uncertainty item is shown in Daily Audit history but is not a current Safety Net warning unless new evidence shows a missed qualifying role, an unresolved current source gap, or a CRITICAL ledger consistency problem.
